Create a production sprite atlas for a warm, believable Japanese anime VTuber teacher. This is an adult woman around thirty, with natural adult anatomy and a softly realistic premium 3D anime rendering style: nuanced skin, subtle subsurface shading, restrained eye size, a rounded natural chin, expressive gentle teal-brown eyes, thin elegant silver spectacles, dark chocolate hair in a loose low ponytail, fine flyaway hair, a modest navy cardigan over an ivory blouse with a muted sage bow. She should look approachable and professionally dressed, with understated fabric detail and no doll/chibi proportions, no theatrical jewelry, no exaggerated makeup. Match a warm soft daylight key from viewer-left with mild fill, realistic soft shadows, no dramatic rim light. Clean sophisticated Japanese cartoon beauty with believable human proportions. Transparent RGBA background, no scene, no desk, no labels, no grid strokes.
Arrange exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows in a wide 2:1 rectangular sheet, with empty transparent gutters. TOP ROW: four IDENTICAL front-facing ARMLESS adult busts, each extending continuously from the top of hair to below the waist, including an anatomically continuous neck, collar, shoulders and torso. The shoulder silhouette is 1.8 times the visible head width. The head is only one third of the bust height. Her shoulders are relaxed. Remove both entire arms cleanly at shoulder joints so separately rigged sleeves can attach. Same identity, camera, hairstyle, glasses, proportions, position, skin tone and illumination in all four top cells. Top cell 1: gentle closed-mouth smile, eyes open. Top cell 2: exactly the same with eyelids briefly closed in a natural blink. Top cell 3: exactly the same with a modest open speaking mouth, not a large grin, eyes open. Top cell 4: exactly the same with modest open speaking mouth and a blink. Faces must be perfectly registered so local eye and mouth patches can be used on cell 1.
BOTTOM ROW: cell 1 one long navy cardigan upper-arm sleeve hanging straight vertically, round shoulder at top, elbow at bottom; cell 2 a corresponding straight forearm sleeve, elbow at top, ivory cuff and realistic relaxed hand at bottom, slightly bent fingers; cell 3 a realistic open five-finger hand with slim wrist at bottom, palm toward camera, anatomical natural adult scale; cell 4 a realistic gently curled gripping hand with wrist at bottom. Each limb isolated, same navy fabric and light from viewer-left. The limb cells are independent animation parts, no extra busts, no extra faces. All parts fully within their own cells and separated by transparent space. High quality natural 3D anime assets, no white fringe, no baked shadow outside the silhouettes.
classroom: A beautiful calm Japanese classroom environment rendered as a sophisticated soft realistic 3D anime film scene, portrait 5:9 aspect ratio. Empty room, no person and no character. Camera is close to a seated teacher at a simple oak teaching desk, eye level with the expected face, not looking down from the ceiling. Quiet warm natural daylight enters from tall windows on viewer-left; outside is greenery and a subtle spring blossom tree, not an explosion of pink flowers. In the rear, a dark sage chalkboard, modest wood bookshelves, a few neatly arranged books and a small green plant. Background softly out of focus, elegant and uncluttered, warm cream walls, credible scale, physically believable soft shadows and natural wood texture. Avoid gothic dark drama, avoid brilliant orange bloom, avoid exaggerated wide-angle perspective. Composition should frame an adult teacher's bust centrally: leave the middle upper two-thirds unobstructed. At precisely 76 percent down the image, show the BACK EDGE of a plain warm oak tabletop, horizontal across the entire image; the empty tabletop extends to its front lip at 84 percent down. The solid modest oak desk FRONT occupies the remaining bottom 16 percent. Desk spans full image width, no props on its surface, no chair or furniture obstructing the center. Consistent viewer-left key light that will blend with a navy-cardigan realistic anime character. Polished but natural welcoming teaching room.

authoring.background:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: portrait Japanese anime classroom backdrop for a VTuber teacher, used behind a movable character.
A sumptuous, warmly sunlit Japanese classroom in a polished contemporary anime film background-painting style. Eye-level locked portrait composition. Tall windows along the LEFT reveal blue sky and softly defocused cherry blossom branches, sheer curtains glow with afternoon daylight. Large dark sage-green chalkboard across the upper middle/right with only faint circles and arrows, no readable text. Refined ivory walls, warm wooden trim, a small bookshelf at the edges, subtle plants. Foreground wooden teacher lectern at the very bottom, polished honey-brown wood, front with carved inset panels and understated fine golden trim. Its top surface is horizontal at about 80 percent of image height, empty for separately composited props. Teacher will occupy center from 33 to 82 percent image height; keep that area uncluttered with clean contrast. Warm soft bloom, beautiful detailed wood grain, nuanced painted light and shadow, delicate dust motes and soft pink cherry blossom reflections. High-end anime key-visual background artwork, sophisticated inviting school atmosphere, rich detailed painterly scenery, not simple geometric vector blocks. No people, no faces, no teacher, no mugs, globes, books or pointer on lectern; those are animated separately. No captions, watermark, logos or readable writing. Portrait aspect ratio FIVE to NINE.
